prompt:
A black-and-white CHILDREN'S COLORING BOOK page, square 1:1, 1080x1080.

THIS IS A MACRO CLOSE-UP SHOT, LIKE A ZOOMED-IN PHONE CAMERA PHOTO TAKEN TOO CLOSE. The subject is so close to the "camera" that it does NOT fully fit in the frame: the top of the round cell character is CUT OFF by the TOP edge, its rounded sides are CUT OFF by the LEFT and RIGHT edges, and the little jar below it is CUT OFF by the BOTTOM edge. There must be ZERO empty white background space visible anywhere in the image — every part of the 1080x1080 canvas is covered by either black line-art or white space that belongs INSIDE a drawn shape. If you can see plain empty background at any edge, the drawing is WRONG — redo it bigger and closer.

SCENE (draw it oversized, then let the frame crop it): A big round cheerful cartoon CELL character — a simple round body with a smaller round smiling face (two dot eyes, a big happy smile) drawn inside it near the middle, like a cell with a friendly nucleus-face — is happily blowing a chain of three or four simple round bubbles/droplets out of a tiny rounded spout on the top of its head, like a bubble-blowing toy. The bubbles float upward and are simple plain circles (some with one small curved highlight line inside, never a spiral, never a face). Below the cell character sits a small round-bellied jar with a simple rounded lid, catching the biggest bubble as it drops in — the jar is smiling too, a simple curved line for a mouth. Keep the background almost bare aside from two or three small simple rounded sparkle marks (a tiny plus-sign or four-pointed star shape, NOT a radiating starburst pattern) near the bubbles — no other objects.

STYLE — coloring book line art: BOLD, THICK, EVEN BLACK OUTLINES on pure WHITE. Every shape fully closed. NO shading, NO grey tones, NO hatching, NO gradients, NO colour fill, NO solid black fills anywhere (eyes may have a small solid pupil only). Simple, cheerful, chunky shapes with open white space INSIDE each shape for colouring.

STRICTLY FORBIDDEN:
- Any visible empty white background, wall, sky or margin space — the artwork must be so zoomed-in and oversized that it touches or crosses every one of the four edges, with elements literally cut off by the edges.
- ANY spider, spider legs, spider eyes, web, or spiderweb pattern anywhere in the image.
- ANY finished thread, string, strand, or fibre shape anywhere — the bubbles must stay simple round circles, never elongated or string-like, and never connected to each other by a thin line.
- ANY starburst, radiating burst, sparkle rays, sunbeam rays, radiating speed lines, or halo of rays anywhere.
- ANY rectangle, box outline, picture frame, panel edge, border line or vignette around the whole picture.
- NO text, letters, numbers, words, captions, labels, signatures or watermarks.
- NO speech bubble or thought bubble (added separately afterwards).
- NO goat, no animal body, no udder, no human figure or human face anywhere.
- NO fighting, no scary imagery, no sad or worried character.
